problem: Let $a=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -4 \\ 8 \\ -6\end{aligned}]$ and $b=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1 \\ 3 \\ -1\end{aligned}].$ Find the orthogonal projection of $a$ onto $\text{Span}{b}.$
worked_solution:
The orthogonal projection of $a$ onto $\text{Span}{b}$ is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{proj}}_{b}\,a & =\frac{b\cdot a}{b\cdot b}b \\  & =\frac{2\cdot 2+1\cdot (-4)+3\cdot 8+(-1)\cdot (-6)}{{2}^{2}+{1}^{2}+{3}^{2}+(-1)^{2}}b \\  & =\frac{4+(-4)+24+6}{4+1+9+1}b \\  & =\frac{30}{15}b \\  & =2b \\  & =2[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1 \\ 3 \\ -1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 2 \\ 6 \\ -2\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
